payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_credentials.py::test_the_default_emitters_line_carries_no_credential stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/events.py. The claim was "`session._default_emit` prints each `Agent` event as its log redacted it, before the size bound, with the token that log holds, in every field `describe` renders. The witness emits six events through a log handed the cell's token. A parsed `text` event and a parsed `tool_use` event each carry the token and a GitHub token. A raw line carries the token and an AWS access key id. A `detail` carries the token and an Anthropic API key. Two raw lines start the token, and then a GitHub token, ten characters before `describe`'s 160-character cut. No printed line holds the token, its first ten characters, any of the three shapes or `ghp_`. Each line equals `describe` of the event the log read back. Handed `None`, the log prints the token and still redacts the three shapes. A log whose `events.jsonl` is a directory refuses every write and still prints each line redacted. A `text` event over `BOUND_CHARS` carries the token and a GitHub token in its first 160 characters. It prints as redacted, before the bound, while the log stores it bounded. Its line holds neither credential and is no `(bounded` line.". Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_events.py::test_describe_renders_every_kind_and_variant[Agent-agent: (raw) qqqqqqqqqqq], tests/test_implement.py::test_a_line_that_is_not_an_event_is_bounded_at_capture, tests/test_implement.py::test_a_raw_line_is_shown_and_never_read_as_an_event, and the criterion's witness did not fail.
